reviewer: game031_review independent actual-image reviewer; Jev answers unread

scores.name: Visual identity
scores.reason: Distinct first-person voxel scene, teal/warm-earth palette and restrained shared menu language; no avatar art or unrelated effects.

scores.name: Object appeal
scores.reason: Block surfaces have visible irregular speckles and face shading; actual edited and unsupported-bridge images make the construction objects tangible. Shapes remain intentionally simple.

scores.name: Background
scores.reason: Actual final-world horizon is open/fog-limited, while the reached cave has readable floor/ceiling and blue-gray depth. Sky and terrain are simple; no claim of rich generated scenery.

scores.name: UI integration
scores.reason: Final portrait/320/landscape feedback is separated from controls and aiming; material names/counts and selected outline fit the same calm style.

scores.name: Composition
scores.reason: World/central aim remain primary in final desktop and portrait captures, with grouped lower palette; 320px and short landscape devote substantial area to controls but remain legible.

scores.name: Gameplay readability
scores.reason: Matched after-images show clear reticle, progress region, target border and placement ghost; all eight named/count-bearing cards, buttons and selection are readable. Feedback no longer obstructs aim or Jump.

scores.name: Motion/effects
scores.reason: Actual recorded mining image contains progressive target-face cracks and the captured before/after edited scenes show concise changes without a hand/tool overlay. Static evidence supports restrained visible feedback; exact animation feel/sound timing was not independently experienced, so credit is limited.

scores.name: Finish
scores.reason: Actual title/settings and final playing layouts share coherent typography/buttons/spacing; initial repeat-stripe and mobile feedback conflicts were independently corrected. Simple sky and sometimes empty feedback strip remain prototype polish limitations.

gate_scope: Independent AI Visual gate for the technical prototype, not human enjoyment or publication permission. Source/build/functional/publication gates remain separate.
closure_evidence: The actual final-layout390/320/844PNG images were opened after the fixes. Their report records nonempty feedback and zero feedback overlap withHUD/crosshair/progress/actions/joystick/material cards. Before images and original findings remain intact.
remaining_limits: Human fun/comfort and author playtest unperformed.
Physical iPhone/Android, heat, audio perception and motion-sickness testing unperformed.
Only recorded visual states were reviewed; no universal mobile display/performance guarantee.
Simple sky/plain geometry and residual empty feedback strip are nonblocking prototype polish limitations.
